input_text: Building an e-commerce platform with user management, product catalog, order processing, and payment. Need to support 10k concurrent users, 99.9% uptime. Team of 5 developers split across frontend and backend. Must integrate with Stripe for payments and SendGrid for emails.

Multi-tenant SaaS analytics dashboard. Each tenant has isolated data. Real-time event processing with 5-second latency. Must support custom metric definitions per tenant. Compliance: SOC2, GDPR. Tech preference: TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis.

Existing monolithic Django app serving 500k users. Need to extract payment and notification services into separate services. Must maintain backward compatibility during migration. Current stack: Django 4.2, PostgreSQL, Celery, Redis. Team has Kubernetes experience but no service mesh.
